Animate/abstract lexicons are small general glass-box assets (pronouns+person-nouns / informational nouns), proper-noun-free, NOT tuned to test items.
Low-frequency targets (spurn~1, withdraw~4) may fall below MIN_OCC=4 and drop from the rankable set -- recall@K is over RANKABLE targets; n_targets_rankable reported.
